scope: One bounded retrospective target-exposed G1 source analysis; source metadata inspection only before this approval; no scientific reductions or joins performed by reviewer.

resolved_method_clarifications.issue: PRED CGA blank water inputs must not become observed zero quantities.
resolved_method_clarifications.resolution: Protocol explicitly separates Excel blank-as-zero formula reproduction from physically recorded zero water; missing entries retain unresolved preparation provenance.

resolved_method_clarifications.issue: Two linear chart trendlines share one series.
resolved_method_clarifications.resolution: Protocol counts the underlying populated source pairs once; duplicate trendlines do not supply additional standards or independent evidence.

approved_rules: Preserve exact eight original hashes, per-source failure states, historical source resolvers and predecessor label.
Use all worksheet metadata, including hidden/nonnumeric sheets, finite explicit reference queue and no original execution/mutation.
Reproduce original source stock/working-standard formulas and chart linear response-on-concentration regression with free intercept, all populated pairs and no invented weighting/exclusions.
Treat regression reconstruction separately from correct standard preparation and calibration/sample applicability.
Require explicit source-defined calibration/sample or run/batch relationship before individual range classifications; absent relationship yields null range counts and unassessable component.
Restrict preparation joins to explicit within-campaign sample/fraction identities; reject ambiguous, duplicate, unmatched and UNKNOWN keys.
Reuse C01 arithmetic and inspect only new common preparation relationship to 5-CQA.
Separate physical shots, observations, preparations, standards, technical injections; preserve invalid spills and valid zeros, original denominators and analytical/model-domain distinction.
Preserve historical models, measurements, masks, thresholds and decisions; no corrected predictor or causal bias correction.
Keep raw values, joins, private paths and source diagnostics outside public Git.
